class: A money figure the user reads under one name (an 'adjustment cost', a 'premium left') is computed by two different formulas in two places, so an alert or rule fires on a number the user never sees on the screen that shows that figure.
mechanism: The T-19 checker (ofo_app/adjustment_check.py:157) uses adjust_money.adjustment_cost: full bid-ask spread of every open leg x quantity + a flat Rs 40 per leg; the Compare's cost row (ofo/adjustment/compare.py:220-231) is the approach's charges + half the spread of each contract it trades; REQ-159 names the Compare figure as T-19's input.
